title: 국내판
prompt: Match the energy of a bold crayon poster: red and orange crayon burst strokes radiating around the title, black outlined four-point sparkles scattered around. Gyomyo is small in the bottom-right corner (keep the huge wide head and tiny stubby body exactly like the references). POSE: shouting into a red megaphone, one paw raised, sound waves coming out. In the very bottom-left corner a small messy pile of navy blue card backs with a yellow paw print and stars. Keep the middle and left of the lower half empty background.
